translationRepairs: On the bingzi new moon of the twelfth month Song sent Liu Hong and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
On the bingzi new moon of the twelfth month Song sent Liu Hang and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
s0031 has 劉沆; 沆 is Hang, so Liu Hang is correct and Liu Hong misreads the given name.
Twelfth month, on the bingzi new moon, Song dispatched Liu Hong and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
Twelfth month, on the bingzi new moon, Song dispatched Liu Hang and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
The literal likewise misreads 劉沆 as Liu Hong; Liu Hang matches the Chinese name.
the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaozing Hall.
the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaoqing Hall.
s0055 has 昭慶殿; 昭慶 is Zhaoqing, and Zhaozing is a transcription error.
the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaozing Hall.
the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaoqing Hall.
The literal has the same hall-name error; Zhaoqing correctly renders 昭慶.
On xinhai day Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sage Li came to court.
On xinhai day Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sa Geli came to court.
s0084 has personal name 撒葛裏 after the office 太尉; that is Sa Geli, not an English phrase Sage Li.
On xinhai day, Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sage Li came to court.
On xinhai day, Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sa Geli came to court.
The literal likewise invents Sage Li from 撒葛裏; Sa Geli restores the personal name.
On jiyou day of the fourth summer month Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshi and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi were dispatched to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.
On jiyou day of the fourth summer month Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshen and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi were dispatched to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.
s0115 has 耶律侯哂; 侯哂 is Houshen, so Houshi truncates the name.
Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day, dispatched Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshi and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.
Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day, dispatched Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshen and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe.
The literal has the same incomplete reading of 侯哂; Houshen matches the Chinese.
Because the court was about to attack Xia, Yongchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu was dispatched to inform Song.
Because the court was about to attack Xia, Yanchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu was dispatched to inform Song.
s0124 has 延昌宮使; 延昌 is Yanchang, whereas Yongchang would be 永昌.
Because about to attack Xia, dispatched Yongchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu to inform Song.
Because about to attack Xia, dispatched Yanchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu to inform Song.
The literal likewise misreads 延昌 as Yongchang; Yanchang is the correct palace name.
On bingshen day an edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Zhucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.
On bingshen day an edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Shucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.
s0125 has 耶律庶成; 庶成 is Shucheng, not Zhucheng.
On bingshen day, edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Zhucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.
On bingshen day, edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Shucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present.
The literal has the same misreading of 庶成; Shucheng matches the Chinese given name.
On wuchen day of the ninth month, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with funeral gifts.
On wuchen day of the ninth month, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with parting gifts.
s0133 has 贐禮; 贐 are parting/farewell gifts, not funeral gifts.
Ninth month, on wuchen day, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with funeral gifts.
Ninth month, on wuchen day, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with parting gifts.
The literal likewise mistranslates 贐禮 as funeral gifts; parting gifts is accurate.
On xinchou day Yuanhao sent envoys presenting local products; an edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.
On xinhai day Yuanhao sent envoys presenting local products; an edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.
s0139 has 辛亥; that is xinhai, and xinchou would be 辛丑. The next unit’s 壬子 also follows 辛亥 consecutively.
On xinchou day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys presenting local products; edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.
On xinhai day, Yuanhao dispatched envoys presenting local products; edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them.
The literal has the same sexagenary error; xinhai correctly renders 辛亥.
On gengwu day the court went to Yu'er Marsh.
On gengwu day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
s0155 has 鴛鴦濼; 鴛鴦 is Yuanyang, not Yu'er.
On gengwu day, went to Yu'er Marsh.
On gengwu day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
The literal likewise misreads 鴛鴦濼 as Yu'er Marsh; Yuanyang Marsh matches the Chinese place name.
On xinchou day of the fourth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
On xinhai day of the fourth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
s0162 has 辛亥; that is xinhai, not xinchou (辛丑).
Fourth month, on xinchou day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
Fourth month, on xinhai day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
The literal has the same sexagenary misreading; xinhai correctly renders 辛亥.
On wuchen day the Emperor attended the Cool Hall, tested jinshi, and granted rank to sixty-eight including Wang Tang and below.
On wuchen day the Emperor attended the Cool Hall and conferred the jinshi degree on sixty-eight men, including Wang Tang.
s0189 has 放進士王棠等六十八人; 放進士 means conferring the jinshi list, not testing candidates, and including Wang Tang is the natural reading of 王棠等.
On yiyou day of the seventh autumn month Prince of Bin Suige died.
On yiyou day of the seventh autumn month Suige, Prince of Bin, died.
s0191 has 豳王遂哥: title 豳王 plus personal name 遂哥; Suige, Prince of Bin separates them clearly.
Autumn, seventh month, on yiyou day, Prince of Bin Suige died.
Autumn, seventh month, on yiyou day, Suige, Prince of Bin, died.
The literal likewise fuses title and name; Suige, Prince of Bin restores 豳王 as title and 遂哥 as the person.
